annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulation (EU) 2017/746 as regards transitional provisions for certain in vitro diagnostic medical devices and deferred application of requirements for in-house devices
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulation (EU) 2017/746 as regards transitional provisions for certain in vitro diagnostic medical devices and deferred application of requirements for in-house devices
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal to amend the EU In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation 2017/746, extending transitional periods by risk class because of limited notified body capacity during COVID-19, and deferring in-house device requirements. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends validity of Directive 98/79/EC certificates to 26 May 2025
Staggered transition for first-time notified body devices: class D 2025, C 2026, B and A sterile 2027
Sell-off deadlines extended up to 26 May 2028
Enters into force on day of publication due to urgency
